contracts: (Cleanup-validation selector executes with nonzero discovery and records its result.) AND (Fixture inventory selector executes with nonzero discovery and verifies the size bound.) AND (Restore drill selector executes with nonzero discovery and verifies timestamped samples and percentile inputs.) AND (Route-validation selector executes with nonzero discovery and records its result.) AND (The exact drill selector is discovered and passes after observing persisted restored-content validation evidence.) AND (The timing selector is discovered and passes with documented approval-time exclusion in every affected sample.)
selector_intents: Execute the OperationsBoundaryTests substitute-root drill selector and fail when persisted evidence lacks a sample-associated restored-content validation result.
Execute the representative-fixture inventory selector and fail when total size exceeds 100 MiB or the check is not bound to the selected fixture.
Execute the timing-calculation selector and fail if any sample includes approval time or lacks documented exclusion metadata.
Run restored-Workspace route validation and fail when the result is skipped, absent, or not persisted in drill evidence.
Run substitute-root cleanup validation and fail when the result is skipped, absent, or not persisted.
Run the substitute-root drill evidence recorder and fail when documented timing samples or percentile inputs are absent.
